title: $TRANSLATE (SQL) | InterSystems SQL Reference | InterSystems IRIS Data Platform 2026.1

examples.sql: SELECT TOP 20 Name,$TRANSLATE(Name,', .''-') AS AlphaName FROM Sample.Person WHERE Name %STARTSWITH 'O'
SELECT TOP 20 Name,$TRANSLATE(Name,', ','^^') AS PiecesNamePunc FROM Sample.Person WHERE Name %STARTSWITH 'O'
SELECT TOP 20 Name,$TRANSLATE(Name,', .''-','^^') AS PiecesNameNoPunc FROM Sample.Person WHERE Name %STARTSWITH 'O'
